classification: Independent executable-source contract review; no model or candidate execution.

original_preparation_preserved.known_finding: Root found that v1 unconditionally indexed raw_response on the actual initial refused readiness poll. That prevented the generation claim before any generation. V2 preserves the original preparation and fixes only this receipt interpretation plus its isolated private path.

reviewed_contract: The exact original six complete exposed sources, source-derived spelling data, thirteen retained name spans, generic prompt, model/runtime/options, strict marker restoration, production script guard and original semantic criteria remain bound. Only request format differs from the closed source-spelling candidate.

The grammar payload wrapper is outermost around the existing source-context projection, so source context is added first and only response_schema changes before the immutable native request builder and observer. Every actual request must equal its complete frozen candidate. Builders restore on success and failure; second/partial requests reject.

The worker retains actual returned JSON before parsing or script/marker rejection; it requires strict JSON, exact same-segment once-only markers, unchanged source metadata, exact source-slice restoration and the unchanged final translation guard. It stops the remaining cases on the first operational, protocol, structure, script, marker or time failure without retry.

Actual per-case full render and token vectors must equal independently reviewed native preparation, actual prompt_eval_count must match, normal stop and nonempty final text are required, thinking must be empty, and generated count must remain strictly below 2048. Per-case unload acknowledgement and empty residents are checked.

The prerequisites require intact actual continuation build/native/validation reports, measured completion, samples, raw receipts, six emitted candidate grammars, all 285 original probe outcomes and the sentinel, with an independent native evidence freeze. Exact native report and complete raw evidence were independently cleared in the separately bound actual-stage review.

V2 allows only the exact index-zero refused /api/version receipt with no response, immediately followed by a successful raw pinned-version reply. Repeated/late/malformed refusal or a missing raw/complete response on another call still rejects. The original separately declared closed-error sentinel path retains full raw HTTP evidence.

Independent source review and actual native evidence are not execution authority. The runner requires a separate root receipt binding this plan, source review, native freeze and all execution files, an exclusive model slot and an exclusive one-attempt claim. The worker checks actual parent PID/create-time and its own process group/session.

The corrected monitor is byte-identical to the already-reviewed monitor: four-CPU affinity, summed owned RSS and PSS samples including retained/group children, unreadable measurement rejection, init/case/total limits, final elapsed comparison after cleanup, and leader-independent TERM/KILL cleanup. The runner adds final phase/source/disk/daemon checks.

controls.scope: Read source and retained result; independently checked its hash/source bindings. Did not rerun candidate controls.
controls.new_7_methods_cover: Actual retained readiness success; original KeyError; malformed first refusal; repeated/late refusal; every one of the 23 successful calls missing raw/response/complete/status; altered/error/incorrect version; order or absent successful readiness.

actual_native_review.scope: Six full prompts, actual zero-token native conversions, all 285 candidate probes, unsupported sentinel, raw/resource/unload/cleanup; no translation generation.

limitations: Grammar correctness and marker preservation do not establish actor roles, pronouns, names in ordinary generated prose, negation, quantities or full meaning. Every actual final translation still needs original-criteria independent review.
The fixed six sources are exposed development data. This review does not authorize fresh validation, more cases, production/default changes or whole-app resource approval.
Sampling can miss transient memory peaks and summed RSS can double-count shared pages; the preserved report describes those limitations.
Actual future root receipt/native freeze and resulting outputs must be reviewed against these exact sources; their existence is not inferred from source clearance.
